cohort: Infants admitted to a well-baby nursery during both a pre-pandemic (March 18, 2019 - March 17, 2020) and pandemic (March 18, 2020 - March 17, 2021) period.
finding: During the COVID-19 pandemic, well-baby nursery admissions, multiparous deliveries, and NICU transfers decreased, while nulliparous deliveries and in utero marijuana exposure increased.
